embed.title: !egg
embed.description: Alerts for raid eggs before they hatch, so you know a raid is coming. Eggs are tracked by level. For hatched bosses, see `{{prefix}}help raid`.

fields.name: By level
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}egg level:5` — level 5 eggs
`{{prefix}}egg level:3-6` — a range of levels
`{{prefix}}egg everything` — every level
Level names: `legendary` (5), `mega` (6), `mega_legendary` (7), `ultra_beast` (8), `elite` (9), `primal` (10), `shadow` (11-15), `shadow_legendary` (15)

Use one level name per command; for more, use a pipe: `{{prefix}}egg legendary | mega`

fields.name: Filters
fields.value:
`valor` / `mystic` / `instinct` / `harmony` (or `red` / `blue` / `yellow` / `gray`) — team holding the gym
`ex` — EX-eligible gyms only
`"gym:Town Hall"` — one gym by name or id (quote names with spaces)

Example: `{{prefix}}egg level:5 valor d:1500`

fields.name: RSVP updates
fields.value:
By default you get one alert per egg.
`rsvp` — also alert again when its RSVP counts change
`rsvp_only` — only alert when the raid has RSVPs
`no_rsvp` — the default (one alert, no RSVP updates)

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
`d:1500` — within 1500 m of your location
`d:500 location:home` — measure from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:city_centre` — only in these areas instead of your `{{prefix}}area` list

fields.name: Message options
Remove and mute
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}egg remove level:5` (or `remove legendary`)
`{{prefix}}egg remove everything`
`{{prefix}}egg remove id:7` — one rule by the id shown in `{{prefix}}tracked`
`{{prefix}}egg mute id:7 duration:2h` — pause one rule without deleting it (`{{prefix}}help mute`)
